facts.clause: Janna can Recast to send the tornado early.
She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.
Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
Janna refunds […]% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.
Janna summons a magical monsoon, Knocking Back nearby enemies then healing nearby allies
After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.

description.clause: On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
